factual_claims.claim: Throughout the reporting period, InCoax experienced a transitional phase marked by weaker-than-expected sales and delayed customer projects, yet concluded its most intensive development phase by launching key products including the D2501—fully integrated into Nokia's platform—and the D2508 for multi-dwelling units.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'Net revenue for 2025 amounted to SEK 48.1 million, compared with SEK 74.5 million in the previous year... This is not satisfactory... At the same time, we have completed key parts of our product development... Our first product, D2501, is now fully launched in Nokia's platform... In parallel, we have launched D2508 through our own channels.' Directors' Report also references delayed customer projects.

factual_claims.claim: To address financial performance and position the company for commercial execution, management initiated structural cost reductions projected to lower ongoing costs by more than 40 percent, representing annual savings of approximately SEK 25 million heading into 2026, with the objective of achieving positive cash flow within the coming twelve months.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'Compared with 2025, we have reduced our ongoing costs by more than 40 percent, corresponding to more than SEK 25 million on an annual basis... Cash flow is to improve through increased sales, higher conversion, and improved operational efficiency... The objective is to reach cash flow neutrality during the coming year.'
